question_en: What was agreed on the SSB burst set?
original_query: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WHERE a.content CONTAINS 'SSB' AND a.content CONTAINS 'burst' RETURN m.meetingNumber, a.resolutionId, a.content ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, a.resolutionId LIMIT 10
reference_query: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WHERE a.content CONTAINS 'SSB' AND a.content CONTAINS 'burst' RETURN m.meetingNumber, a.resolutionId, coalesce(a.contentWithEquations,a.content)+CASE WHEN a.note IS NULL OR a.note='' THEN '' ELSE '\n'+a.note END AS content ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, a.resolutionId LIMIT 10
